notes.title: Funny moments in development
notes.notes:
As a developer, I’ve become desensitized to the scare elements I design. It's like setting up a haunted house a hundred times—knowing exactly where every ghost is makes it impossible to be scared.

"Trigger A and the ghost will jump out," I mutter while checking the test list.

On the way to trigger A...
A ghost that wasn’t supposed to appear suddenly jumped out.

"What the hell! I haven’t even reached point A, why did the ghost come out?"

Sometimes, my own bugs can scare me.
